cohort: Children born in Taiwan between 2004 and 2008
finding: Maternal and neonatal risk factors, including Cesarean section, maternal asthma, maternal allergic rhinitis, premature rupture of membranes, male gender, preterm birth, ventilator use, antibiotics use, allergic rhinitis, and atopic dermatitis, were associated with the development of transient early asthma, persistent asthma, and late-onset asthma.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of all three asthma phenotypes.
